pages.title: Protection Wants Seconds
pages.text: Marine meals replenish the very food reserve on which the learned protective effect depends.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Keep the acquired protective effect until it genuinely triggers with an empty hunger bar. A separate native protection handler spends food while reserves remain, while the zero-food branch supplies native invulnerability
